# What of viewer/ and data/ goes into a prebuilt package (phase 10), copied
# with its folders as they are in the repo. One pattern per line, relative to
# the repo: "**" is any number of folders, "*" any name within one; a line
# starting with "!" takes out what an earlier line put in. dist/package/
# assemble.sh reads it; nothing else is copied from these two folders.

# The viewer of the game: the page, styles, modules, three.js and the assets.
viewer/index.html

viewer/js/**
viewer/vendor/three/three.module.js
viewer/vendor/three/three.core.js
viewer/vendor/three/addons/**
viewer/vendor/three/LICENSE
viewer/assets/**
# Not the tests, the test helpers, the dev server or the web version.
!viewer/js/**/*.test.js
!viewer/js/core/testing.js

!viewer/js/live/devserver.mjs
!viewer/js/**/README.md
!viewer/js/web/**
!viewer/assets/**/SHA256SUMS
